_: Soft agent — character perception. v0.0.1 PLACEHOLDER. The soft agent reads a character's location (star-ref into a spatial coord block), their stats (passport or shell sub-block), their witnessed events (witnessed:<character> sibling block), and the current scene's frame plus canon. From this it composes what the character perceives: what they see, hear, sense, know. The output is character intention — typically a free-form text submission from the player, shaped by the soft agent into something the character could plausibly express. Vapour mode: streaming during keypress. Liquid mode: final shaped intention written to frame:<scene>:<entity-pos>,1. Reference design: xstream-play/blocks/xstream/soft-agent.json.
